sessionCompletion.title: Practice completion
sessionCompletion.subtitle: The share of started practices finished all the way through. Practices stopped partway are still counted up to however far they got.
sessionCompletion.dropoffNote: Practices stopped partway got to about {{items}} items on average. If it keeps stopping around the same spot, that's usually where it gets hard.
sessionCompletion.streakDisclaimer: ‘Days practiced’ on the patient home counts any day with at least one item answered. That's a different measure than completion rate here.

weeklyReport.title: Language & cognition activity record
weeklyReport.loadFailed: We couldn't load the record. Please try again shortly.
weeklyReport.emptyRecords: No activity records yet. They'll build up once your loved one completes the ‘Standard activity’ in patient mode.
weeklyReport.limitation1: This is a self-measured record done at home with a caregiver. It is not a medical diagnosis or a standardized test result.
weeklyReport.limitation2: Each week has few items (10-20), so weekly swings are large. Please look at the trend across several weeks rather than one week's rise or fall.
weeklyReport.limitation3: Testing conditions (background noise, device, time of day, how they're feeling) vary each time, so this isn't an apples-to-apples comparison.
weeklyReport.limitation4: ‘Responsiveness’ scores 0-3 based on how they respond — from hearing the sound to tapping the screen. It measures whether and how fast they respond, not right or wrong.
weeklyReport.limitation5: ‘Pronunciation’ for ‘Repeat after me’ and ‘Read aloud’ is a 0-100 approximation scored by speech recognition. It's sensitive to background noise and speech habits, so treat it as a reference alongside the pass/fail result.
weeklyReport.limitation6: ‘Average detected’ for ‘Motor speech (DDK)’ counts syllable repetitions recognized within a fixed time. Higher usually means faster speech movement, and ‘Passed’ means the target count was reached.
